task_label: TASK-M6B.5 direct OpenAI flag-gated transport delegation
acceptance_criteria: With TRANSPORT_LAYER_ENABLED absent or false, llm_gateway uses the exact existing silo dispatch and passes no transport dependency.
With TRANSPORT_LAYER_ENABLED true, only the existing direct openai provider path constructs OpenAICompatTransport from the selected gateway service and injects it into the OpenAI gateway.

OpenAI gateway uses the injected transport only for its existing service-level request and second-call-history seams; gateway-owned policy, tool loop, synthesis, response shaping, cost persistence, and streaming remain unchanged.
Gemini, Google, Ollama, OpenRouter, unsupported providers, and the Codex placeholder do not receive or enable a transport path.
Add hermetic focused regressions for flag-off, flag-on OpenAI, and non-OpenAI isolation.
task_prompt: Implement only TASK-M6B.5 in allowlisted files. Preserve exact legacy dispatch when TRANSPORT_LAYER_ENABLED is absent or false. When true, enable only the direct provider=openai path: construct OpenAICompatTransport from the selected OpenAIGateway.service in llm_gateway and pass it as an optional dependency into OpenAIGateway. In that gateway, use the injected transport only instead of direct service calls at the existing service-level request/history seams. Do not add OpenRouter routing or touch Gemini, Google, Ollama, Codex, streaming, Websearch, fallback, credential, policy, synthesis, response-shaping, cost, docs, or Git behavior. Return status, changed_files, command_results, summary, and blockers as concise JSON-compatible output.
